Container.Name: ListBridge
Container.Overview: ListBridge: 3-Way synchronization daemon between AnyList, Google Keep, and Amazon Alexa lists. Synchronizes item additions, cross-offs/checkmarks (preserving crossed-off history), unchecks, and deletions across one or multiple lists.

Config.Name: AppData Storage Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage directory for state.json, alexa_auth.json, and sync.log

Config.Name: List Names
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of list names to sync across AnyList, Google Keep, and Alexa (e.g., Grocery,Hardware,Costco)

Config.Name: Sync Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: Time in seconds between sync cycles (Recommended: 60)

Config.Name: Google Keep Master Token / App Password
Config.Description: Your Google Keep OAuth Master Token (aas_et/...) or App Password

Config.Name: Amazon Alexa Email
Config.Description: Your Amazon account email address (Leave blank to run 2-way AnyList/Keep sync only)

Config.Name: Amazon Alexa 2FA OTP Secret
Config.Description: Your Amazon 2FA Authenticator Base32 Secret Key (used to automatically generate 6-digit TOTP codes when refreshing session tokens)

Config.Name: Alexa List Name Mapping (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional mapping if a list has a different name in Alexa (Format: AnyListName:AlexaName, e.g., Groceries:Shop). Leave blank when list names match 1-to-1.

Config.Name: Internal Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal container path for state and auth files
